title: Safety board readiness audit — Mula–Mutha

requirements.detail: NadiTwin datum is relative (0 = upstream WSE), not MSL
FABDEM/local terrain MSL not cross-validated against NadiTwin relative WSE
No independently surveyed bank crest layer wired for operational margins
Partial survey depth exists; full crest/XS verification required
Phase 4/6 validateChainageAlignment ok vs River.EYE 10 m geometry
Legacy threshold defaults (2.0 m) are class assumptions, not surveyed

recommendation: Keep safety boards locked until datum, crest, and threshold inputs are independently verified. Do not auto-transform relative WSE to MSL.
